TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A space-art scene dominated by a large planet on the right, mostly in shadow with a sunlit crescent along its upper-left rim revealing mottled tan and brown terrain. A smaller cratered moon hangs lower left of it, also half dark. The background is a deep red and amber nebula filled with dust clouds, scattered stars, and a bright glowing star near the planet's upper-left limb. The whole image is framed by black bars at top and bottom.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Low-angle shot of two national flags flying on tall dark flagpoles topped with gold finials against a golden, partly cloudy sunset sky. On the left is the flag of Israel (white with two horizontal blue stripes and a blue Star of David at center), on the right the flag of Saudi Arabia (green with white Arabic calligraphy and a white sword beneath it). The flags billow in the wind, suggesting a diplomatic or partnership theme.
TEXT: لا إله إلا الله محمد رسول الله
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A monochrome dark-green digital illustration styled like a printed circuit board, with white circuit traces, pads, and rectangular chip blocks filling the upper two-thirds. At the center, a cluster of pale rounded rectangles resembles a memory stack and is filled with rows of repeated alphanumeric strings. The bottom third shows the board disintegrating into a huge pile of angular rubble and shattered block fragments, as if the circuitry is crumbling into debris.
TEXT: QI13jV6Q1JHs13q13 (this string repeated many times across the central block rows)
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A tall vertical red neon sign photographed against a near-black background, with the word MARKET repeated four times from top to bottom in glowing orange-red tube lettering. Exposed red wires and tube supports zigzag between the letters, and faint reflections and small window lights are visible around the dark frame, giving a moody nighttime storefront feel.
TEXT: MARKET MARKET MARKET MARKET
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A close-up of a yellow diamond-shaped winding-road warning sign with a black border, showing a bold black S-curved arrow pointing upward. The sign is mounted on a galvanized metal post against a soft-focus backdrop of dense evergreen trees. Two bolts fasten the sign, and a small white sticker printed with the number 12 is affixed to the lower corner of the diamond.
TEXT: 12
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Donald Trump stands in profile in the Oval Office, hands at his sides, gazing out the curved triple windows at snow-covered trees outside. The room is dressed with heavy gold damask drapes and scalloped valances, the US flag and the presidential standard on poles, the carved Resolute desk cluttered with papers and folders, a side table lined with framed family photographs, and an upholstered sofa in the foreground.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A composite render of the United States Capitol building rendered in muted grayscale beneath heavy, dark storm clouds, its dome and wide steps dominating the right side of the frame. In the left foreground a beige rectangular sign bolted to a bright red post leans into view, printed with a small American flag graphic above bold distressed black capital letters. The selective red of the post and flag is the only saturated color in the otherwise desaturated scene.
TEXT: GOVERNMENT SHUTDOWN
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A red rotating beacon or alarm siren light mounted flush on a dark ceiling, its ribbed translucent dome blazing so intensely that the whole concrete ceiling and the wall below are washed in deep red glow. Horizontal pipes and conduits run across the ceiling, and the lower half of the frame dissolves into blurred bands of saturated crimson light. The framing has rounded corners like a social-media post.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A huge illuminated street clock in a black ornate housing dominates the right of the frame at night, its glowing white face with bold black numerals showing roughly 6:56. Around it, a nighttime city scene: skyscraper windows, a red street banner for a children's theater, white bus-lane regulatory signs on a pole, and a dark storefront sign reading Hilton in gold serif letters, with a small lamp attached to the clock post.
TEXT: The NEW 42ND STREET celebrates / NEW VICTORY THEATER / NEW YORK'S THEATER FOR K[IDS] AND FAMILIES! / BUS LANE TOW & FINE $205.00 MINIMUM / BUSES RIGHT TURNS ONLY 7AM-10AM 4PM-7PM MON THRU FRI / Hilton
SYMBOLS: clock, numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: An extremely dark, low-light frame where nearly everything falls into blackness. Faintly visible are one or two human figures: in the foreground a person's head bowed with a hand pressed over the forehead and eyes, and just behind them the rim-lit profile of a second face with light catching the nose, lips, and shoulder of a light-colored shirt. The mood is somber and intimate, with the vast majority of the image reading as pure darkness.
